headline: Old Tower Hill Road neighborhood plan and Form Based Code, plus ways to educate voters on bond issues.
summary: Talks cover EDC surveys, statistical analysis once handled by the former SMART Committee, and a possible online economic dashboard for South Kingstown. Staff will also update residents on an electrical supply business at 138 Main Street.
items: Old Tower Hill Road neighborhood plan: follow-up on Form Based Code and next steps
Restarting EDC statistical analysis work once handled by the former SMART Committee
Educating voters on bond issues during elections
SMART dashboard: developing or reestablishing an online economic dashboard for South Kingstown
Election of officers at January meeting
location: Town Hall Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI
